concept: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보 데이터에 반영해줘. 그 다음 스킬의 최신 버전을 사용하여 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 이번에 반영한 주제가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.

prompt_en: A photorealistic fine-art portrait: a serene, still, ethereal gothic photograph with flowers and floral ornament, caught in a quiet held moment. A botanist stands beside a narrow observation bench in a night-pollination glasshouse. The supplied photograph informs her visible facial appearance, dark chin-length bob and fine, wispy fringe. The character and the situation are fictional. Her face is angled gently toward a fresh white trumpet flower at shoulder distance, her eyes attentive to the pale moth resting across its lower petal, with her mouth softly at rest and a few fine hairs catching the light. One hand holds the folded-back edge of a thin vellum shade between her thumb and two fingertips. The raised fold opens a small clear interval beside the flower, admitting an oblique view of the moth while the remaining screen shades the plant. Her bent elbow stays close to her torso, and her other forearm rests lightly along the bench. The blossom belongs to a potted living plant on that same bench; a neighbouring bud remains closed. The moth's tented wings have a faint powdery texture, its small legs visibly supported on the lower petal. The open bloom, the closed bud and the held fold make the observation feel like an interrupted routine at a particular stage of the plant's night. Her black botanical lace blouse has a softly gathered high collar and sleeves that settle into small working folds. A modest cluster of dark fabric flowers is pinned at one shoulder, relating the ornament to the living ivory blooms rather than competing with them. The shoulder cluster includes a folded black silk rosette with tiny stitched cloth edges; the separate ivory flower has thin botanical petals carried by its own green stem into the pot. Dark iron glazing ribs rise into narrow pointed arches beyond the bench, their lower panes clouded by fine condensation. A partly screened maintenance doorway behind her releases a slender warm golden strip, touching the hair edge and a few flower rims; the vellum returns a very soft ivory fill to her face. Quiet gestures, softened edges of light and dark romantic tonal weight make the ethereal gothic mood visible. Matte charcoal, deep black, restrained antique gold and pale ivory stay gently separated, with readable shadow texture and softly rolled highlights. Narrow, quiet charcoal intervals lie immediately beside her cheeks, separating her nearer face from peripheral flower stems and the shoulder rosette. The capture camera observes from beside the bench at roughly chest height, in an oblique three-quarter view, using a natural 50mm perspective. Compose a vertical 4:5 medium-close frame that holds her face, both forearms, the raised shade edge and the moth-bearing flower together. Moderate depth of field keeps the face and the consequential contact legible while the humid arches and farther blossoms recede softly. The image has natural skin texture, fine hair detail, credible lace and vellum surfaces, and a subtle photographic grain.
